label: plastic bottle
description: Common beverage container made from PET plastic.
disposal_method: Rinse and recycle with plastics.

label: aluminum can
description: Lightweight can used for drinks, made of aluminum.
disposal_method: Rinse and place in metal recycling.

label: glass jar
description: Reusable or recyclable container made of glass.
disposal_method: Rinse and recycle with glass items.

label: cardboard box
description: Used for packaging and shipping, made from paper fibers.
disposal_method: Flatten and recycle with paper/cardboard.

label: pizza box (greasy)
description: Cardboard box with food grease, contaminates recycling.
disposal_method: Compost if possible or dispose in trash.

label: plastic bag
description: Flexible plastic film often used for carrying items.
disposal_method: Dispose in trash or recycle at special drop-off.

label: styrofoam container
description: Foam food container made of polystyrene.
disposal_method: Place in general waste.

label: tin can
description: Food storage can made of steel or tin-plated metal.
disposal_method: Rinse and recycle with metals.

label: milk carton
description: Liquid food container made from paper with plastic lining.
disposal_method: Rinse and recycle in mixed recycling.

label: juice box
description: Multi-layered carton for beverages, often with foil lining.
disposal_method: Recycle in beverage carton stream if accepted.

label: paper towel
description: Soft absorbent paper, often soiled after use.
disposal_method: Compost if unused or dispose in trash.

label: newspaper
description: Printed paper publication, easily recyclable.
disposal_method: Place in paper recycling bin.

label: plastic cutlery
description: Single-use forks, spoons, knives made of plastic.
disposal_method: Dispose in trash.

label: chip bag
description: Flexible packaging made of plastic and aluminum layers.
disposal_method: Dispose in trash.

label: batteries
description: Power source for electronics, contains hazardous materials.
disposal_method: Take to a hazardous waste or e-waste center.

label: light bulb
description: Illumination device with glass and metal parts.
disposal_method: Special drop-off for CFL/LEDs or dispose in trash.

label: e-waste (old phone)
description: Electronic device containing various reusable metals.
disposal_method: E-waste center or authorized recycler.

label: clothes (cotton)
description: Wearable cotton fabric, biodegradable and recyclable.
disposal_method: Donate or recycle at textile drop-off.

label: clothes (polyester)
description: Synthetic fabric used in garments.
disposal_method: Recycle with textile recyclers.

label: toothbrush (plastic)
description: Personal hygiene item with plastic body and nylon bristles.
disposal_method: Dispose in trash or send to special recycler.

label: broken mirror
description: Reflective glass item with safety coating or paint.
disposal_method: Wrap in newspaper and dispose in trash.

label: ceramic mug
description: Drinkware made from non-recyclable ceramic material.
disposal_method: Dispose in trash.

label: food waste
description: Organic kitchen scraps like fruit peels and leftovers.
disposal_method: Compost or dispose in organic waste bin.

label: garden waste
description: Yard trimmings like grass, leaves, and small branches.
disposal_method: Compost or put in green waste bin.

label: disposable diaper
description: Single-use item made of absorbent materials and plastic.
disposal_method: Dispose in trash.
